svg.aria-label: B2-F05 — the gate closing on purpose: a record designed to be uninterpretable
svg.desc: Log-log plot of pressure change and Bourdet derivative for the deliberately inconclusive control, wellbore storage C_D = 10000 over a record truncated at 3 hours. The two curves lie almost on top of one another across the whole plot, which is the wellbore-storage identity holding nearly everywhere: the test barely escapes storage before it ends. A vertical dashed rule marks the crossover at 2.90 hours, leaving 0.10 hours of record after it. No window is shaded, no straight line is fitted, and no permeability or skin appears anywhere in the figure, because the rule declined. Its stated reason was: no point is both flat enough and free of the storage identity.

svg.text: The rule declined one condition earlier than the protocol anticipated. It was expected to fail on the minimum extent; it failed on the storage identity,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: meaning no point in the record is even admissible. That is a stricter refusal than the one designed for, not a weaker one.

svg.text: This control matters less than it was meant to. It shows the gate closing on a record built to be hopeless — but the primary case at C_D = 1000, which

svg.text: was built to succeed, also had the gate close on it.
